 2026 World Championships | WAG All-Around Final Live Blog
 Lauren / 6 hours ago October 23, 2026 
 Welcome to the live blog for the WAG all-around final at the 2026 World Championships, held in Rotterdam, Netherlands.
 Please refresh your browser every few minutes to see the most recent updates, which will appear at the top of the page.
 FINAL STANDINGS 
 1. Skye Blakely, United States, 55.733
2. Lyudmila Roshchina, Russia, 55.199
3. Ke Qinqin, China, 55.032
4. Kaylia Némour, Algeria, 54.998
5. Sugihara Aiko, Japan, 54.765
6. Elena Colas, France, 54.666
7. Claire Pease, United States, 54.232
8. Alba Petisco, Spain, 54.198
 ROTATION 4 
 3:50 pm. Inquiry is rejected!
 3:46 pm. Oh they are ABSOLUTELY doing an inquiry for Némour on floor…
 Waiting to see what happens before posting rankings!
 3:42 pm. WOW, the judges REALLY wanted Némour on that podium I think…a 13.266 on floor! But still just a bit too short, she misses out by a third of a tenth!
 3:40 pm. Kaylia Némour ALG FX: She needs above a 13.3 on floor which is a reach for her based on the majority of her routines but not out of the realm of possibility. Double layout, slightly short but not bad. Hit the whip whip to triple full, also a bit short with a hop. Switch ring through to tour jeté half. I think a triple wolf turn? Front tuck through to double pike, low chest and a small hop. Switch full. 13.266
 3:37 pm. Sugihara Aiko JPN BB: I wasn’t typing at the very beginning but think she had the leap mount, switch ring to Korbut? All hit! Front aerial to split jump to straddle jump. Okay I had to stop typing again but she hit the acro series, full Y turn, some other stuff lol, no falls that I saw, switch ring had a bobble. Double pike, almost sticks, ends up wobbling on her toes. 13.566
 Her all-around total today is a 54.765!
 Kishi Rina JPN UB: 13.066
 3:34 pm. Skye Blakely USA FX: 1.5 to front full with a step forward which is such a funny opening pass for a worlds all-around final but if she wins with that I support it. Double front is a bit cowboyed, gets it to the stag jump. I think a tour jeté half to switch ring for her leap pass. Wild arms in the triple wolf turn. Switch full. Front double full, minor form in the air. She only needs a 12.4 to win so I THINK she’s got it. She’s already crying! 12.933
 She has a 55.733 to end her day!
 3:29 pm. Lyudmila Roshchina RUS FX: Stuck the double layout to start! 2.5 to barani, great landing again, tiny hop to the side. Switch ring to switch half. Clean stuck double full. Double wolf turn. Clean double pike in the air, short on the landing with a hop. Mostly FANTASTIC routine though. 13.400
 She finishes with a 55.199! That’ll be a podium finish for sure.
 Lorrane Oliveira BRA BB: 11.066
 Ellie Black CAN UB: 13.833
 3:27 pm. Maïana Prat FRA UB: 12.200
 She otherwise had a mostly good day, but bars is a killer for her. 52.066
 3:26 pm. Elena Colas FRA FX: Whip full through to double tuck, small hop. I didn’t see details or what the second pass was but saw her get the landing. Switch ring through to tour jeté half. Front tuck through to double pike, a bit low in her set, hop back. Switch half, gets the wolf turn at the end. 13.100
 Her all-around score is a 54.666!
 Lisa Vaelen BEL BB: 11.000
 3:25 pm. Giulia Perotti ITA UB: 14.366
 Ke Qinqin with a 55.032 AA, Claire Pease with a 54.232, Zhang Qingying and Giulia Perotti both with a 54.098.
 3:23 pm. Alice Kinsella GBR BB: Hit the mount and double wolf turn, front aerial, wobbles. Split jump to straddle jump. Short on the side aerial, still goes into the loso and falls. Switch leap to switch half, a little slow. 2.5 with a big step to the side. 12.166
 Claire Pease USA VT: Cheng, noticeable form throughout in the air (some hip, some knees), goes crooked off the table and lands with one foot OOB, small hop. I14.133
 3:20 pm. Ke Qinqin CHN FX: Triple wolf turn. Super clean triple full! Split jump full. Front tuck through to clean double full, small hop back. Switch ring through to switch ring half. Great landing on the double tuck. Switch ring half. Great routine! 13.266
 Alyona Glotova RUS VT: 13.066
 Naomi Visser NED VT: Yurchenko full, a little low off the table but gets some good distance and the form looked nice in the air, hop back. 13.200
 Sofia Tonelli ITA UB: 13.300
 3:19 pm. Lia Redick CAN VT: 13.666
 Breanna Scott AUS UB: 13.100
 Greta Mayer HUN BB: 12.033
 Alba Petisco goes 54.198, her personal best international all-around score, and second-best all-around score EVER! She had a 54.350 at nationals in 2025.
 3:16 pm. Zhang Qingying CHN FX: Split jump full. Sticks the full-in. Front full basically stuck? Lifts one foot slightly. Switch ring to tour jeté half. Double pike, step back. 12.866
 Flavia Saraiva BRA VT: 13.066
 Alba Petisco ESP VT: Ooh, she had a great day. Yurchenko 1.5, two tiny steps on the landing. 13.633!
 ROTATION 3 STANDINGS 
 1. Skye Blakely USA 42.800
2. Lyudmila Roshchina RUS 41.799
3. Ke Qinqin CHN 41.766
4. Kaylia Némour ALG 41.566
5. Elena Colas FRA 41.566
6. Zhang Qingying CHN 41.232
7. Sugihara Aiko JPN 41.199
8. Alice Kinsella GBR 40.599
 ROTATION 3 
 3:07 pm. Skye Blakely USA BB: Nice on the mount sequence. Triple wolf turn. Super solid standing full. Front handspring front tuck, wobble. Solid punch front pike. Switch to switch half looked fine today from this angle? Front aerial to split jump to straddle jump. Step back on the double tuck. 14.200
 3:06 pm. Naomi Visser NED FX: Whip to triple full with minor ankle form to front tuck. Double L turn is ALMOST a triple tbh, to double spin. Tour jeté half. Hit the double tuck with a small hop. Switch leap through to switch half. 2.5 with a GREAT landing! 13.100
 Sugihara Aiko JPN UB: Toe half to straddle Jaeger, toe full to Pak, Maloney to Gienger, a little low. Short handstand before giants to arabian double front dismount, hit! 13.533
 3:03 pm. Lyudmila Roshchina RUS BB: Punch front mount. Switch ring to bhs to split ring jump, maybe slightly slow in those connections? Side aerial, check. Front handspring front tuck, little hop. Wolf jump to sissone, tiny check. Front aerial to split jump to Korbut. Clean double wolf turn. Small hop on the double tuck. She’s cooking today! 13.433
 Alyona Glotova RUS FX: 12.700
 2:59 pm. Elena Colas FRA BB: Switch leap mount to switch leap to straddle jump. Solid side aerial loso. Little fall forward on the double wolf turn but pulls it back. Hit the switch half. Front aerial to split jump to bhs was solid. Hop back on the double pike. Great! 13.933
 Lia Redick CAN FX: Oh she is STRUGGLING today. 12.066
 Lorrane Oliveira BRA UB: 13.700
 2:57 pm. Lisa Vaelen BEL UB: Wasn’t typing for this but it was a hit routine! Biggest error was coming up a bit short on the dismount with a big lunge forward. 12.833
 Alba Petisco ESP FX: 13.333
 2:54 pm. Ke Qinqin CHN BB: Had a step back after the mount leap series and also a little stumble on the front handspring front tuck. Front aerial to split ring jump to Korbut. Switch to bhs to stag ring jump, minor wobble. I think a bhs to jump series after that, then dismounts with a double tuck, set was low, ends up short, sits it. SIGH. 13.833
 Ellie Black CAN VT: 13.433
 2:53 pm. Alice Kinsella GBR UB: Toe half to piked Jaeger, a little low but catches no problem, Ricna to Pak, Maloney to Gienger, toe full with a slight arch over, to arabian double front dismount, chest down, step. 13.466
 2:52 pm. Maïana Prat FRA VT: Yurchenko 1.5, some knee form in the air, hop forward. 13.666
 Flavia Saraiva BRA FX: 13.200
 2:49 pm. Zhang Qingying CHN BB: Switch leap mount, switch half to Korbut, slightly off on the catch there but nothing severe. Gets the roundoff layout. Switch ring to bhs to split jump, lovely. Switch side to straddle jump, doesn’t connect to the back loop and catches that a bit far forward. Switch to split jump half to straddle 3/4, full turn, double pike, slightly short, lunge forward. 14.233
 Sofia Tonelli ITA VT: 13.500
 Giulia Perotti ITA VT: 13.100
 Greta Mayer HUN UB: 13.033
 2:47 pm. Claire Pease USA FX: Double-twisting double layout, little steps back. Double double, step back. Switch ring to switch half. 1.5 to rudi I think was her third pass? I always miss the entry to this pass. Some form in the air. Triple wolf turn. 2.5 with super crossed legs. 13.733
 Abigail Martin GBR UB: Toe full was a bit late, Maloney to Tkachev, hop change to straddle Jaeger, mild form on the last few elements, gets the Pak, van Leeuwen, full-in dismount, hop back. 13.166
 Breana Scott AUS VT: 12.066
 2:45 pm. Kaylia Némour ALG BB: Loso mount into two more losos, wobbles at the end of the series. Bhs bhs layout with a little bounce. Short side aerial, little wobble. Switch to switch half, bounce. Front aerial to straddle jump to Korbut. Double wolf turn. Dismounts with a double pike, hop back. 14.500
 Kishi Rina JPN VT: 13.900
 2:42 pm. Touch warmups underway! Longines isn’t breaking ties so I think they’re broken but I guess I’m going with what they have because I don’t have it in me to do the math.
 ROTATION 2 STANDINGS 
 1. Skye Blakely USA 28.600
2. Lyudmila Roshchina RUS 28.366
3. Ke Qinqin CHN 27.933
4. Sugihara Aiko JPN 27.666
5. Elena Colas FRA 27.633
6. Kaylia Némour ALG 27.232
– Alba Petisco ESP 27.232
8. Lisa Vaelen BEL 27.133
– Alice Kinsella GBR 27.133
 ROTATION 2 
 2:38 pm. Elena Colas FRA UB: Getting a replay of this! Hit the opening sequence, I wasn’t typing but she got all of her connections and it looked really nice overall, I caught up at the van Leeuwen, toe full to full-in with a small step. 14.433
 Maïana Prat FRA FX: 13.300
 2:35 pm. Alyona Glotova RUS BB: She looks so mad before mounting, I love her. Game face! Bhs mount with a check. Switch leap to split leap. Side aerial loso with some form and she’s a bit short on the landing, can’t hold on, fall. Switch half to Korbut. Off again on the double wolf turn. Step back on the double tuck. 11.066
 Lyudmila Roshchina RUS UB: Komova II to inbar piked Tkachev I think?? It was hard to see the feet in the entry, to Pak, Chow to Gienger, piked Jaeger, short handstand before the toe-full to full-in, two small steps. 14.333!
 2:33 pm. Giulia Perotti ITA FX: Full-in, chest down, small step back. Front layout through to double pike, chest down and a tiny hop. Memmel was a little sketchy but got it around, hit the ring leap series pretty well I think, then switch half into the corner before her last pass, a double tuck, big hop back. 12.866
 2:32 pm. Lia Redick CAN BB: 10.466
 2:28 pm. Ke Qinqin CHN UB: Endo to Endo half to Maloney to Pak, toe full to Chow to Gienger, minor form, slightly short handstand before giants to double layout dismount, step back. Mostly lovely work! 13.900
 Sofia Tonelli ITA FX: 12.566
 2:27 pm. Alba Petisco ESP BB: Hit the loso mount. Switch to switch half, a little short, check. Wild on the double wolf turn but gets it around! Nailed the triple flight series. Side aerial, slight check. Cross split jump half. Dismounts with a double pike, tiny hop. 13.466
 2:25 pm. Zhang Qingying CHN UB: Weiler to Weiler half to Pak. Maloney to Tkachev, toe-on to toe full to full-in, nice steady set! 13.933
 Breanna Scott AUS FX: 12.466
 2:24 pm. Sorry, we had a commercial so I’ve just been twiddling my thumbs. Some scores!
 Lorrane Oliveira BRA VT: 13.066
 Flavia Saraiva BRA BB: Had a fall. 13.233
 2:21 pm. Kishi Rina JPN FX: 13.166
 Lisa Vaelen BEL VT: 14.033
 2:19 pm. Kaylia Némour ALG UB: Inbar full was rough, doesn’t connect, but does the inbar layout Tkachev in mixed grip to Ezhova to Maloney to staler full to Downie to Pak to Chow half, full-twisting double layout, step back. Got scary at the beginning for a sec but good recovery. 14.866
 Alice Kinsella GBR VT: Yurchenko double full, some form, some pike down, chest down on the landing, step back. 13.833
 2:17 pm. Claire Pease USA BB: Triple wolf turn goes well, switch leap to split jump to Onodi, solid. Bhs loso loso with a big wobble then fall. Front aerial to straddle jump to bhs, little check. Side aerial. Switch half. Hit the 2.5 dismount with some form throughout. 12.533
 Greta Mayer HUN VT: 13.400
 2:15 pm. Skye Blakely USA UB: Stalder full to Church, Downie to Pak, safely through both! Toe full to van Leeuwen, minor separation, toe half to front giant to double front half, stuck! Oh, this routine has gotten EASY for her. 14.400
 Ellie Black CAN FX: 12.900
 Abigail Martin GBR VT: 13.800
 2:13 pm. Naomi Visser NED BB: Nice bhs mount, front aerial, a little wonky in the side aerial to bhs but she corrects and stays on, switch to side somi, big wobble on the double spin, dismounted with a 2.5 with a hop. 12.533
 Sugihara Aiko JPN VT: Yurchenko double full, tiny steps back into the salute, great vault! 14.266
 2:12 pm. Should be starting up again in a minute or two! Jk looks like we’re starting NOW.
 ROTATION 1 STANDINGS 
 1. Alyona Glotova RUS 14.333
2. Skye Blakely USA 14.200
3. Ke Qinqin CHN 14.033
– Naomi Visser NED 14.033
– Lyudmila Roshchina RUS 14.033
6. Claire Pease USA 13.833
7. Alba Petisco ESP 13.766
– Giulia Perotti ITA 13.766
 ROTATION 1 
 2:06 pm. Giulia Perotti ITA BB: Wasn’t typing for this but a hit routine! Solid on the flight series. Hit the dismount well. 13.766
 Lia Redick CAN UB: 12.033
 2:04 pm. Sofia Tonelli ITA BB: 13.300
 Lisa Vaelen BEL FX: 13.100
 2:01 pm. Alba Petisco ESP UB: Straddle Jaeger, Church to Pak, short handstand before the Maloney to bail to toe-on to toe shoot, nice! Blind full, minor ankle separation, to a stuck full-out. 13.766
 2:00 pm. Elena Colas FRA VT: Yurchenko full, a bit piked down, small hop back. 13.200
 Flavia Saraiva BRA UB: 13.300
 Alice Kinsella GBR FX: 13.300
 1:58 pm. Kaylia Némour ALG VT: I don’t even want to watch but here we go. Idk what even happened? Just like…simply did a Yurchenko layout. Or I guess pike, it was kinda piked. It was like she just wasn’t ready and did a timer? Lord. Like her block looked fine? Okay, just did the rewatch and yeah, on the entry she kinda misses the springboard and does the roundoff onto the safety collar.
 1:57 pm. Ke Qinqin CHN VT: Looks like a successful Yurchenko double full! Got the replay, it had a hop back. 14.033
 Greta Mayer HUN FX: 12.166
 1:55 pm. Breanna Scott AUS BB: Off on the layout series. Hit the side aerial, front aerial, double wolf turn, punch front, step back on the double pike. 12.900
 1:53 pm. Claire Pease USA UB: Endo half to inbar full to inbar to Komova II to Tkachev, I think that random inbar was supposed to be the Komova II but she wasn’t feeling it and did an inbar as a cover and it worked! Pak, lovely handstand before the Chow half, toe half to double front half, deep but stuck. 13.833
 Kishi Rina JPN BB: 12.500
 Abigail Martin GBR FX: 13.133
 1:52 pm. Zhang Qingying CHN VT: Assume a Tsuk full but we ofc did not see it. Ah yes, there it is in the replay. Lunge back. 13.066
 1:51 pm. Kaylia Némour’s vault score just came in as a 12.366 with a 3.6 D so I assume she balked the Yurchenko double full soooooo goodbye everyone! This final is over. I’m sure we’ll get a replay. We’re of course watching an ad right now on Peacock.
 Naomi Visser NED UB: 14.033
 1:47 pm. Sugihara Aiko JPN FX: Double L turn. Double layout, small hop back. I think a 1.5 through to double tuck after that, I missed the early part of the first skill, but looked good, small hop back. Leap pass looked good I think? Memmel turn. 2.5 to front layout, lands with toes OOB. Sticks the double pike at the end! Queen. 13.400
 Skye Blakely USA VT: Yurchenko double full, two little hops back. 14.200
 Ellie Black CAN BB: 12.366
 1:46 pm. Alyona Glotova RUS UB: Toe half to piked Jaeger, messy toe full to Downie to Pak, Maloney to Gienger, mostly nice, minor leg separation, full-out with a step back. 14.333
 1:44 pm. Lyudmila Roshchina RUS VT: Hit the Yurchenko double full, hop back. 14.033
 1:43 pm. Maïana Prat FRA BB: Hit the mount and then a long prep for her bhs loso loso, hits it with a check. Switch leap to switch alf to bhs, little form things here and there. The switch was really nice though! Side aerial to split jump, double wolf turn, side somi, and strong landing on the double pike dismount! 12.900 – D looks lower than usual? Just a 4.9!
 Lorrane Oliveira BRA FX: 13.100
 1:41 pm. Touch still happening! Should be a couple of minutes more.
 1:38 pm. Athletes are out! I’m watching on Peacock btw, and we have an ad right now. Following live scores on Longines .
 1:34 pm. With intros taking a while and the touch warmup still to come, we probably won’t get started until around 1:40 pm? Check back in a bit1
 1:32 pm. Athletes are being introduced now!
 1:27 pm. Hi! So as with MAG, I didn’t have time to do an individual preview, but here are some thoughts that may be helpful if you missed prelims!
 Though Claire Pease finished seventh in quals – shocking tbh! – and is rotating with the group that starts on bars, I think she proved in the team competition that she is one of the best all-arounders in the world and a top contender for gold, so if she can repeat that kind of performance today, it’ll undoubtedly be between her and Kaylia Némour – who led in qualifications with a 55.999 – in the top spot.
 Ke Qinqin, Elena Colas, and Skye Blakely will also be strong podium contenders, and could go for gold if the stronger two have too many mistakes. I was impressed with Lyudmila Roshchina in prelims and think she could be in the mix, and though Sugihara Aiko was down in 21st in qualifications, I think out of all of the lower-ranked competitors from that session, she has the most potential for a massive upset.
